subject: sqldf installation error for R 3.0.2 on Amazon EMR (Fedora/Amazon Linux) 64 bit

messages.author: 23c1db677ebb781b
messages.subject: sqldf installation error for R 3.0.2 on Amazon EMR (Fedora/Amazon Linux) 64 bit
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to install sqldf package from CRAN repository on Amazon EMR (Fedora/Amazon Linux) 64 bit instance using

install.packages("sqldf")

I get the error message as :
Error in library(tcltk) : tcltk is not a valid installed package and
tcltk is not available for R 3.0.2

So, I tried FAQ #5 on the sqldf home page (http://sqldf.googlecode.com) i.e. setting options(gsubfn.engine = "R")

But, even after setting the gsubfn.engine, I retry the command install.packages("sqldf"), it fails with the same error.

I need to somehow install "sqldf" package in R without tcltk. Please suggest some options.

messages.author: 17e30776ec2a7fb1
messages.subject: Re: sqldf installation error for R 3.0.2 on Amazon EMR (Fedora/Amazon Linux) 64 bit
parts:
Try it again in a fresh session making sure you spell the option correctly.

If it still does not work then there is a problem then you are likely using a non-standard R distribution and you will have to find a better one.
